name: DriveNow Rentals
note: Answer key for scripts/benchmark.py only. The QA Pilot engine must never read this file.

bugs.title: Return date before pickup date is accepted
bugs.description: Booking with a return date earlier than the pickup date succeeds and produces a negative price.

bugs.title: Same car can be double-booked
bugs.description: Two bookings for the same car with overlapping dates are both accepted.

bugs.title: Same-day rental is charged 0 days
bugs.description: Rental terms say minimum 1 day, but pickup = return gives 0 days and a $0.00 total.

bugs.title: Customer can view other customers' bookings
bugs.description: Customers can open any /bookings/<id>, exposing other customers' names, emails and prices.

bugs.title: Revenue report open to every role
bugs.description: /admin/revenue is admin-only in the menu but agents and customers can open it by URL.

bugs.title: Car in maintenance can be booked
bugs.description: Kia Picanto is in maintenance but is offered and bookable in the booking form.

bugs.title: Returned or cancelled booking can be handed over again
bugs.description: 'Hand over car' is offered and works for returned and cancelled bookings.

bugs.title: Weekly discount starts at 8 days instead of 7
bugs.description: Terms promise 10% off for 7+ days; a 7-day rental gets no discount (boundary off by one).

bugs.title: Negative daily rate accepted for a car
bugs.description: Adding a car with daily rate -10 or 0 succeeds.

bugs.title: Terms & conditions link is broken
bugs.description: Footer 'Terms & conditions' returns 404 on every page.

bugs.title: JavaScript error on Availability page
bugs.description: Uncaught ReferenceError: highlightToday is not defined.

bugs.title: Tesla Model 3 photo is missing
bugs.description: Car detail page for the Tesla Model 3 shows a broken image (404).

bugs.title: Booking date inputs have no labels
bugs.description: Pickup and return date inputs are not associated with any label.

bugs.title: Availability calendar overflows on mobile
bugs.description: The 15-column calendar has fixed widths and no scroll container; at 390px the page scrolls sideways.

bugs.title: Returned car stays 'rented'
bugs.description: After 'Return car', the car's status remains rented, so fleet counts and availability are wrong.
